name: ToolbarStats
intent: A compact full-width metric strip that groups labeled values into equal-width cells for dashboards, tables, and operational workspaces.
when: Several related headline metrics need to share one compact horizontal region
Metric groups need clear dividers without building a dashboard grid
A toolbar or table header needs persistent summary statistics
whenNot: Only one headline metric is needed -> use MetricCard
Metrics need charts or trends -> use TrendChart
The values are row-level records -> use DataTable

chooseOver.because: ToolbarStats owns equal-width metric layout, grouped dividers, compact density, and negative-value treatment.

groups.note: Ordered groups of pre-formatted label/value metrics.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless; callers compute and format values.

variant.note: Cards renders separate stat cards; table renders one compact divided row.

className.note: Merged onto the root metric strip.

states.cards: Separate stat cards with group dividers and horizontal overflow when needed.
states.table: A bare row of full-height cells separated by borders.
states.negative: Metrics flagged negative use the destructive semantic text color.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ToolbarStats as a generic layout component
commonMistakes.symptom: Non-metric content is squeezed into stat cells
commonMistakes.fix: Use a toolbar or grid component for actions and arbitrary content.

evaluationCriteria.check: ToolbarStats is selected as a widget for a composed metric strip, not as a primitive component.
Every metric renders a label and value; group boundaries and negative semantics remain visible.

usage: Use ToolbarStats to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
ToolbarStats integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups of stat tiles. Tiles within a group sit side by side and share the row width equally; a vertical divider separates one group from the next (e.g. percentage metrics from currency ones).

props.name: variant
props.description: `cards` (default): each metric is its own bordered tile with gaps between them and a divider between groups. `table`: a bare row of full-height cells split by full-height internal dividers — no gaps, no per-tile borders, and no outer outline.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

anatomy.description: ToolbarStats is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
